name: Tiko Timer
subtitle: A calm visual countdown
promotional_text: Turn waiting into something you can see. A big, colourful countdown ring makes transitions and routines calmer for everyone.
description:
Tiko Timer turns waiting into something a child can see. A big, colourful ring counts down so kids always know how much time is left.

There is just one calm screen. Pick a preset or set your own time, watch the ring shrink, and get a gentle cue when time is up. No numbers to decode, no clutter to distract.

It is a friendly helper for transitions and routines — tidying up, taking turns, screen time, brushing teeth, or a quiet countdown before the next activity.

• A large, easy-to-read visual countdown ring
• Quick presets: 1, 3, 5 and 10 minutes
• Pause, resume and reset at any time
• A gentle cue when the timer finishes
• A clean, calm, single-screen design

Tiko Timer opens ready to go, so you can start a countdown the moment you need one.
